lastCompletedStory.title: Fix auditor prompt C.8 and B.5 for cam-cli terminal reality

nextStoryContext: US-001 was the only non-operator story in this PRD and it is now complete; templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md was deliberately left untouched (its generic web C.8/B.5 are correct for downstream projects). Note for any future auditor-prompt edit: the C.8 negative-grep oracle (`! grep -nE "browser verification AND E2E|browser verification.*E2E test"`) trips on ANY sentence containing both substrings in that order, even a correct negation -- avoid reusing the literal banned phrases when rewriting; see patterns.md bullet CAM-228.
